title: HNRNPH1 regulates the neuroprotective cold-shock protein RBM3 expression through poison exon exclusion
model: GFP-RBM3 reporter human iPSC-derived i-neurons (2 Cas9 clones), custom genome-wide knockout library (91,536 guides, 399 non-targeting), 32 C for 72 h, GFP quartile sort
contrast: Low-GFP vs high-GFP bin, paired by sort (6 vs 6: 2 clones x 3 sorts)
paper_calls: 110 genes at FDR 0.05: 15 positive regulators (enriched in low GFP, incl. RBM3) and 95 negative regulators
barcs_calls: 57 genes at FDR 0.10 (26 positive, 31 negative regulators) after calibration to the controls; 93 against the control null centred on the targeting guides
named_hits: 9/10 at FDR 0.10: HNRNPH1 #1, YPEL5 #2, HTATSF1 #3, PNISR #5, RBM3 #6, TNPO3 #7, WTAP #9, WDR26 #10, SNRNP70 #13; UBE2H #159 (FDR 0.54)
verdict: BARCS ranks HNRNPH1 first and calls 14 of the paper's 15 positive regulators and nine of ten arrayed-validated genes; it confirms only 28 of the 95 negative regulators, keeping the strongest splicing factors but not the long MAGeCK tail.
